newsitem.title: POLAND: ALL UNIVERSAL PLN 100 MLN BONDS TAKEN.
newsitem.headline: ALL UNIVERSAL PLN 100 MLN BONDS TAKEN.

text.p: Investors have bought all of Polish trading company Universal SA's 100-million-zloty convertible bond issue, the firm's spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"All the bonds were taken and Universal collected 100 million zlotys," Agnieszka Szostek told Reuters.
She declined to name the investors who bought the bonds.
Universal SA sold 1,000 convertible bonds with a semi- annual 5.5-percent coupon in a private placement to no more than 300 selected investors.
Szostek said the bonds, for which the firm would issue up to 10 million new shares, would be convertible into 10,000 new common shares each between April 1, 1997 and November 30, 2001.
